title: Chapter 136
text:
The tributary of the Tedramira River flowed through the Cloud Valley and led to the sea at the end of the valley.

Han Xiao's landing location was at the edge of the Cloud Valley. According to the information from the Dark Net, the Germinal Organization's ground troops would meet up with the sea troops in the valley.

Han Xiao's goal was to intercept the ground troops. He knew that the two countries would also send their ground troops to intercept him, most likely within the Cloud Valley. If he got too close, he would be discovered. At this juncture, he did not want to come into contact with the troops of the two countries.

Looks like I have to choose a good location.

With this thought in mind, Han Xiao crossed his arms and watched as the people from Fabian Company finished assembling the front and suspension of the truck. They also hung up the cargo compartment that contained the mechanical equipment. As the people from Fabian Company worked, they looked at Frenzied Sword, who was dancing at the side.

"I've delivered the goods. I'm leaving."

"Okay, say hi to Matthew for me." Han Xiao nodded.

Antonio waved his hand, and the helicopter took off and disappeared into the sky. The Fabian Organization was only responsible for transporting the firearms and did not participate in the battle.

Han Xiao sat in the truck and looked at the detailed map sent by the Dark Net. Just as he was about to start driving, his phone rang.

"Hello."

"Black Phantom, you're going to join the Germinal Organization?" Bennett asked in surprise.

"Yeah, you should come and play too," Han Xiao joked.

"… The Dark Net has always been neutral. Don't go overboard. The Germinal Organization's crazy people will bite anyone they catch. I have a headache too," Bennett said helplessly.

"Don't worry, I never cheat my teammates."

Bennett expressed his doubts and said, "Forget it … I have something I need your help with in a while."

In the past two months, Han Xiao had Bennett's phone number and often called him. Furthermore, he was getting more and more famous, so Bennett was also happy to talk to him. They had a good relationship.

Han Xiao put away his phone, shook his head, stepped on the accelerator, and drove along the edge of the valley toward the chosen area.

…

The river passed through the narrow valley and nourished the fertile soil. The terrain was rather diverse. There were plains with long grass, forests, and hills. The scenery was elegant and beautiful. One's eyes were filled with green. It made people feel relaxed and happy. They had an urge to forgive something.

Stardragon had placed a large number of ground troops in ambush here. There were all kinds of war equipment, tanks, helicopters, mid-range missile coverage arrays, and a large number of minefields.

The commander of the ground troops was a Stardragon officer named Huang Qiuming. He had been in the army for more than twenty years and was a serious and meticulous person. The reason why the higher-ups of Stardragon chose him was because they liked Huang Qiuming's steady style. As long as this battle went according to plan, they would definitely win.

In the command vehicle, Huang Qiuming looked at the map that was filled with all kinds of markings and nodded expressionlessly.

The first ambush is a minefield. If the Germinal Organization does not step in, they will miss the time to meet up with the naval forces. Therefore, even if they know that it is a trap, they have to take the risk. The armed helicopters are on standby at all times. They can attack the enemy's minesweepers from the air. The missile car array is aimed at the edge of the forest at all times. Once the enemy crosses the forest, they can attack … "

As long as they followed the plan, the enemy would not be able to escape.

…

The evacuation force of the Germinal Organization in the Southern Continent was a huge fleet of hundreds of vehicles. This large fleet was a mix of the evacuation forces of all the surviving bases.

Lin Yu was the commander, and the person directly in charge of the ground troops was called Ugar, a Caucasian.

Ugar was also very clear that the troops were about to be ambushed. In order to catch up with the naval forces, they had to pass through the Cloud Valley. There was no way to avoid this fierce battle. He was already prepared. The evacuation forces of these bases carried some new experimental weapons with them. There were some powerful things that would definitely surprise the enemy.

These experimental weapons were all important supplies. There were also a few human test subjects of the [Super Soldier Project].

…

The truck made a big circle and stopped at the edge of the Cloud Valley. According to the intelligence, this was the route that the Germinal Organization's ground troops could not take. It was very far.

Han Xiao did not drive into the forest. Instead, he took out a bunch of spider detectors. There were more than forty of them. He activated them through the tablet. These mechanical spiders shook their heads and stood up straight like a group of soldiers waiting for orders.

After two months of accumulation, Han Xiao's technology had improved again. He had updated and strengthened all the existing machines. The spider detectors were installed with low-level smart chips. They automatically detected threat targets and fed back to the tablet. He did not have to look at the screen all the time. They were also added with a new blueprint, SUI anti-radar detection coating. They could better perform undercover detection and were suitable for fixed surveillance.

Han Xiao sent most of the spider detectors into the forest. The remaining few went in the opposite direction to find out when the Germinal Organization would arrive.

While doing this, Mad Blade got out of the truck and noticed that there was an extra line of words in his status bar.

You have entered the [Severe Motion Sickness] status. All attributes -30%.

"What the hell is this?" Mad Blade was surprised. He had set the experience to be 20% realistic. He did not experience the thrill of driving, but the interface faithfully reflected his body's status.

"Do you need me to do anything?" Mad Blade asked. He wanted to see if he could trigger a mission.

"Not at the moment."

Han Xiao shook his head. Mad Blade's combat power was not enough to participate in a war of this level. The only thing he could do was to be a cannon fodder who was not afraid of death.

Now, there must be various minefields and radar detectors in the forest. Entering rashly would attract attention. What he had to do was to wait, make preparations, perfect the plan, and calibrate the other mechanical weapons.

There was still one or two days before the Germinal Organization's evacuation team arrived. Han Xiao had been preparing and waiting in the truck. Mad Blade followed beside him, giving small missions to Mad Blade every day.

Although he felt that Mad Blade had a lot of potential, he would not fully train him. The experience given to Mad Blade was limited compared to the other players at the same time. However, Mad Blade was very satisfied.

Han Xiao also looked at the forums every day. The enthusiasm of the players was still fermenting. He mainly paid attention to the Blue Star board. He could know the progress of the players. They were still at the beginner stage. When they grew up, there would be a big event specifically targeting the players waiting for them. That would be the beginning of the chaos.

The storyline was messed up by me. That encounter of the players might be delayed … or even brought forward?

Han Xiao stroked the stubble on his chin and thought to himself. That was the first time the players had entered the sights of the various novice planets. He still remembered that it had caused a huge uproar in his previous life, causing widespread discussion and praises.

…

That night, the moon was covered by dark clouds. The fog was so thick that it was difficult to see one's fingers.

Spider No.1 lay on the plains under the night sky, not moving at all, faithfully executing the program's orders.

Rumble!

The ground suddenly shook slightly. Spider No.1's sensors detected the vibration and immediately turned in the direction of the vibration source.

The huge Germinal Organization fleet appeared in the distance, and Spider No.1 happened to be in their path.

Spider No.1 loyally sent out the warning signal in the form of a radio wave.

The vehicles were getting closer and closer. Spider No.1 did not move and did not know how to dodge.

Huff!

The huge fleet quickly ran over it, leaving a trail of smoke behind them.

Spider No.1's appearance was only revealed after the smoke and dust dispersed.

Its mechanical body was covered in dust, but it was not damaged at all. Even such a dense number of vehicles could not run it over.
